summary: Screen outgoing evidence and archives, generate CycloneDX SBOMs, verify signed release inventory and rehearse native CLI recovery.
acceptance: Trace distributed bytes to reviewed code, require explicit channel approval and verify downloads and recoverability.
validation: Four CI combinations, dependency audit, archive scan, negative inventory tests and isolated Codex CLI install and recovery.
securityImpact: Publication requires reviewed acceptance references and a separate restricted environment. No destination credentials are used.
